RDPLauncher 1.0.2 shows the computer's full name and address on the widget.

## Fixed

- The address under a computer's name (for example **192.168.1.33**) was cut short with "…". The
  widget now sizes itself to the full name and address. Only a name longer than the widget's
  maximum width is still shortened.

## Updating

Exit the running copy (right-click the widget → **Exit**), replace RDPLauncher.exe with the new one
and start it. Your computers and display buttons are kept.
